responsibility: This header declares the JSON assertion and expectation helpers used by GCC checking-build selftests. It exposes routines and convenience macros for asserting that JSON values are strings, objects, arrays, or integer/string-valued properties with expected contents, making tests over GCC's JSON emitters concise and location-aware. It is the public selftest helper interface for JSON structure validation.
same_name_distinction: Declares the JSON selftest helper functions and assertion/expectation macros used by checking-build tests. In this same-name pair, the .cc provides the concrete validation routines behind those declarations.
